study.question: Observed limitation: the incumbent shares user/context embeddings across tasks, but its history selector and event gate do not consume that context; context enters only the prediction towers. Can task-specific context/event interaction improve history selection over an equally parameterized contextual evidence readout, and do auxiliary gradients through this NEW interaction help or hurt? The shared/live context result g3-r0023-context_shared_live has click AUC0.6662458901 versus0.6659481623 for shared/detached and private/live. Latest coalesced projection AUC0.6657466387 is below its joint control0.6662241275. These are local single-seed observations, not established causal mechanisms.
study.hypothesis: Useful cross-task context learning should be preserved while context is allowed to condition each task's use of observed feedback/target-match history evidence. Introduce q_t=tanh(W_t LayerNorm(context)/sqrt(C)), zero W_t of shape20xC. For each valid history event e_j=flatten(feedback_channels_j outer target_match_indicators_j), form z_jt=e_j dot q_t/sqrt(20). In route cells add z before the inherited self-donor/tanh event gate and pooling; click retains inherited coefficient L1-mass redistribution. In readout cells add the masked mean of the SAME z to task logits instead. Cross location with live/detached auxiliary derivatives from q_t into shared context, leaving W_t and all inherited auxiliary context gradients trainable. Prediction: route/live outperforms readout/live and the historical incumbent; a positive location-by-gradient interaction would provisionally support complementary feedback learning through selection rather than just contextual evidence capacity. No claim that task-specific conditioning itself beats task-agnostic conditioning is tested here.

nearest_work.difference: Archived original section4.3 lines250-277 supplies target-conditioned unnormalized local activation. Inherit its adapted pooling/trunks; add context-conditioned task/event evidence. This is not an exact DIN reproduction or an originality claim.

Pinned benchmark forward lines123-160 and interaction/broadcast definitions204-313 inspected. That code repeatedly aggregates categorical/sequence/task hubs and broadcasts learned affine updates. Here one zero-initialized context projection per task modulates a strictly masked, fixed20-feature event basis before inherited pooling, with a matched readout replacement and a derivative contrast. No hub stack, full attention, tokenization, broadcast implementation or benchmark masking behavior is copied; this is not an INFNet reproduction.

study.proposed_difference: Add only a zero dense tensor W[4,20,C] after all inherited initialization and a stateless FP32 per-example LayerNorm/tanh projection. Both event logits and their masked means are computed in all cells; location chooses the only active destination. W=0 yields the inherited forward function without RNG draws. The two new switches are context_exchange_location and context_exchange_aux_gradient. Auxiliary detachment applies exclusively to normalized context in the new branch, never to its task weights, prediction towers, inherited context use, labels or losses. No train-time cache, autograd probe or gradient surgery is carried over from r0027.
predictions: Primary exploratory contrast: click AUC(route/live)-AUC(readout/live)>0 and route/live improves over historical g3-r0022-selector_disabled0.6662458901. A difference of at least0.0001 is a predeclared prioritization threshold for follow-up, not a significance threshold or guaranteed gain.

Compute D_live=AUC(route/live)-AUC(readout/live), D_detached=AUC(route/detached)-AUC(readout/detached), and interaction I=D_live-D_detached. I>0 together with route/live>route/detached is the predicted pattern for additional beneficial auxiliary context learning through selection. If only D_detached improves, revise toward context-conditioned selection with restricted new auxiliary feedback.

All four cells have the same added parameter count80*C, identical initial outputs, unchanged inherited parameter initialization, and zero new corrections for empty histories. Route cells preserve click coefficient signs and FP32 L1 mass through the inherited normalization, within documented rounding limits.

Before inspecting new results, predeclare existing empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history bins. Report sample/positive/negative counts (6444/427/6017;461684/28818/432866;1001754/55298/946456;1401885/50957/1350928). A history-selection explanation predicts gains outside empty histories; learned shared weights can still change empty-history predictions indirectly. Other task-required slices need host-provided authorized diagnostics and cannot be fabricated from unavailable model inputs.

Report all four AUC/Logloss, click Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, parameter counts, train/wall time, allocated GPU seconds if exposed, examples processed if exposed, peak memory, throughput and latency. Mark unavailable measurements rather than infer them from unrelated timing fields.
falsifiers: If neither route cell improves over its matched readout cell, the proposed advantage of context-conditioned selection is unsupported in this implementation; if readout wins, contextual evidence or easier optimization is the stronger explanation.
If live auxiliary gradients do not help relative to detachment, or I<=0, the predicted additional cross-task gradient benefit through routing is unsupported even if selection helps.

If all changes are within seed/user-cluster uncertainty or regress, retain the incumbent and report a null/negative result. Do not interpret a single small improvement as established mechanism evidence.

Unequal initial predictions/parameters, masked-event influence, target-action influence, unintended detachment of the inherited path, nonfinite gradients, or inability to finish within the per-trial cap invalidate this contrast; retain failed receipts and correct before further science. A failed implementation alone does not refute context/task conditioning.
alternative_explanations: An extra nonlinear context-by-feedback/target-match feature may suffice; readout cells test this replacement using exactly the same matrices and raw event scores.

Any gain may come from route versus logit optimization scale, LayerNorm sensitivity, saturation, coefficient geometry or dense clipping rather than superior information selection. Raw scores are bounded but the two destinations have intrinsically different transformations. A later scale or matched-compute study is needed if this distinction is consequential.
Prior event rank route beat rank readout (g3-r0018-rank_event_route0.6661698163 vs0.6655357893), but this input-only result cannot establish that learned context conditioning transfers.

Historical full context privatization/detachment harmed click, but that changes all auxiliary context derivatives. This study alters only new-path derivatives and cannot be interpreted as a repetition of that earlier intervention.

Prior positive-only and negative-only auxiliary context losses hurt relative to their both-sign control; r0026 occurrence projection was essentially null, and r0027 coalesced projection/norm reduced click quality. These unsuccessful branches motivate a forward interaction contrast; they neither prove beneficial gradient conflict nor refute every gradient method. All recorded model trials succeeded operationally; negative quality is separate from execution failure.

Prior latest_knowledge_usage declared no local effectiveness for industry references. All r0027 variants executed successfully but its central coalesced-projection prediction failed on click. Source adoption is provenance only. Task row capacity is equal between current cells, but there is no task-agnostic forward control, so no task-conditioning priority or isolated superiority claim is permitted.

The frozen official_offline histories can include delayed feedback that would be immature online; auxiliary cart/fav/buy labels are user/category/brand24h outcomes, not direct advertisement conversions. Production point-in-time validity and transfer outside this benchmark are unestablished.
